newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks charge to record high on retail data.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks charge to record high on retail data.

text.p: Mexican stocks sharply extended earlier record gains to reach new historic heights at heavy mid-session dealing on Friday.

Dealers said foreign and domestic bulls kept charging as strong retail and wholesale sales data confirmed the recent flurry of positive data, with a record-breaking Dow Jones providing strong back-up.
The leading IPC share index was up 102.07 points to a new intraday record of 4448.95.
